readings: Count each Order_Items row as one unit of order volume. Divide each product_id's row count by the total Order_Items row count, then take the plain average of those shares across product_ids that appear in Order_Items. For product_ids whose share is strictly above that average, return one unrounded row with their combined row count, their average share, and their average share minus the average across products.

Count each Order_Items row as one unit of order volume. Divide each product_id's row count by the total Order_Items row count, assigning a zero share to products with no order items. Take the plain average across all product_ids in Products. For product_ids whose share is strictly above that average, return one unrounded row with their combined row count, their average share, and their average share minus the average across products.

Measure order volume by summing the numeric product_quantity values in Order_Items. Divide each product_id's quantity sum by the total quantity sum, then take the plain average of those shares across product_ids that appear in Order_Items. For product_ids whose share is strictly above that average, return one unrounded row with their combined quantity, their average share, and their average share minus the average across products.

Measure order volume by summing the numeric product_quantity values in Order_Items. Divide each product_id's quantity sum by the total quantity sum, assigning a zero share to products with no order items. Take the plain average across all product_ids in Products. For product_ids whose share is strictly above that average, return one unrounded row with their combined quantity, their average share, and their average share minus the average across products.
queries:
WITH product_shares AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           COUNT(*) AS row_count,
           COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items) AS share
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY product_id
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share_across_products
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(p.row_count) AS combined_row_count,
       AVG(p.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(p.share) - a.share_across_products AS share_difference
FROM product_shares AS p
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE p.share > a.share_across_products

WITH product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS row_count,
        COALESCE(
            1.0 * COUNT(oi.order_item_id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0),
            0.0
        ) AS share
    FROM Products AS p
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
product_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ps.row_count) AS combined_row_count,
    AVG(ps.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(ps.share) - pa.average_share AS share_difference
FROM product_shares AS ps
CROSS JOIN product_average AS pa
WHERE ps.share > pa.average_share

WITH product_quantities AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS quantity
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         quantity,
         quantity / SUM(quantity) OVER () AS share
  FROM product_quantities
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(p.quantity) AS combined_quantity,
       AVG(p.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(p.share) - a.share AS share_above_average
FROM product_shares AS p
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE p.share > a.share

WITH product_quantities AS (
    SELECT p.product_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)), 0) AS quantity
    FROM Products AS p
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           quantity,
           CASE
               WHEN (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM product_quantities) = 0 THEN 0
               ELSE quantity / (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM product_quantities)
           END AS share
    FROM product_quantities
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ps.quantity) AS combined_quantity,
       AVG(ps.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ps.share) - a.share AS share_above_average
FROM product_shares AS ps
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE ps.share > a.share
